title: Creativology
seoTitle: Creativology — A Decade Rebrand | Lōn Visuals
lede: A rebrand for a decade of innovation: ten years of creativity, design and technology distilled into a logotype that carries the number 10 and the code of the work inside its own letters.

blocks.label: Overview
blocks.title: A decade of crafting digital excellence
paras: Founded in 2014 as a web development and graphic design company, Creativology has grown into a full-service digital agency: web, mobile and desktop applications, UI/UX, branding, print and media consulting.

Ten years on, the numbers tell the story: more than 174 projects, 112 clients and work delivered across 23 countries, from Jordan and the Gulf to the UK, the US, Germany and Australia. The anniversary called for a brand that could carry that decade forward.

blocks.label: The Concept
blocks.title: Ten, hidden in plain sight
paras: The logotype carries the anniversary inside the name itself. In the letters “olo”, the l and the o form the number 10, and the same letters read as the binary 010: a decade of craft and the code behind the work, held in a single word.
Three ideas shape the system. Creativity as design, drawn as a field of dynamic waves. Development through advancement, written in binary. And a decade of legacy, carried by the number 10.

blocks.label: Le Logo
blocks.title: A logotype and its descriptor
paras: The wordmark is set in Slack Light by Due Studio, refined so the l and o lock together. Its descriptor, Dev.Design., folds the agency’s two divisions, development and design, into one short line that says what the studio does.
Three lockups cover every format: the wordmark alone, with the descriptor beside it, and with the descriptor stacked beneath.

blocks.label: Colour
blocks.title: Chartreuse, jungle green, alabaster
paras: A phosphorescent chartreuse gives the brand its charge, set against a deep green-blue-grey and an off-white that keeps it calm.

blocks.label: Typography
blocks.title: Slack Light, by Due Studio
paras: One expressive serif carries the voice, from the logotype to headlines, with its italics for the words that matter.

images.alt: Slack Light specimen with the Creativology wordmark and descriptor

blocks.label: Dynamic Waves
blocks.title: A system in motion
paras: The Dynamic Waves System is the brand’s signature motif: fields of fine lines that bend and flow, symbolising the meeting of creativity and technology. It frames the logotype, carries the anniversary and gives every surface movement.
